views.side: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target is this exact six-cell fairy-wing animation sheet. REPAINT COLORS AND LIGHTING ONLY. Keep exact wing silhouettes, shapes, veins, positions, root joints, six poses, view angles, cell layout and empty gutters unchanged. Do not redesign or move anything.
